limits: Finite application verdict abstraction; exact parser bytes, cryptography, allocation and field validation depend on source/host tests.
Serial Raft caller projection. Separate catalog locks do not establish concurrent-reader snapshot isolation.
Restore precedes disk persistence; no atomic application/disk transaction.
Old/new durable-object failure choice assumes existing whole-object replacement; no new storage fault injection or native execution.
thread_exit stops the calling thread; no global endpoint withdrawal, sibling-thread termination, physical cleanup or quiescence claim.
No-snapshot startup, membership envelope decoding, election/log replay, chunks and suffixes are outside this model; existing separate models/tests remain relevant.
Join fence index is fixed at one; candidates have index two. Recovery can read index one after an interrupted streamed attempt.
